system_suffix: Environment contract: the ONLY valid path argument is the exact relative string "module.py". Never prefix it with /workspace/, ./, or any directory. Only read_file, write_file and run_tests exist; list_dir does not exist. First call read_file(path="module.py"), then write_file(path="module.py",content=<complete corrected standalone functions>), then run_tests(). If a tool returns an error, correct that error before continuing. Do not run tests before a successful write.
reason: LFM2.5 is an always-reasoning model. Initial forced-off trials and text-only non-reasoning SDK metadata were unsuitable. Deployment probe uses native thinking, 4096 output tokens and explicit fixture-path instructions; these combined changes are not an isolated causal comparison. Recall replays identical hashed prompts with native thinking and a larger output budget. DSH UI low/medium/high all alias native high; off is not advertised.
